aiMetadata.description: Fetches the content of a single web page and returns it in a chosen format (markdown, HTML, links, summary, screenshot, or AI-extracted JSON). Choose this to read one specific URL; for many pages use Crawl, and for a structured data pull across several known URLs use Extract Structured Data. Optionally runs browser actions (click, type, wait, screenshot) before scraping. Read-only against the target, so repeating the same call is safe.

extract.name: extract
extract.description: Extract structured data from multiple URLs using AI.

urls.description: Add one or more URLs to extract data from.

url.description: Website URL to extract data from

prompt.description: Describe what information you want to extract.
prompt.defaultValue: Extract the following data from the provided content.

enableWebSearch.description: Enable web search to find additional context.

timeout.description: Timeout in seconds after which the task will be cancelled

mode.description: For complex schema, you can use advanced mode.

auth.description:
Follow these steps to obtain your Firecrawl API Key:

1. Visit [Firecrawl](https://firecrawl.dev) and create an account.
2. Log in and navigate to your dashboard.
3. Locate and copy your API key from the API settings section.

aiMetadata.description: Pulls structured data from one or more known URLs by running an AI extraction against a natural-language prompt and a field schema (simple field list or advanced JSON Schema). Choose this when you need specific typed values from pages you already have URLs for; use Scrape to read raw page content or Map to discover URLs first. Runs as a polled job bounded by the timeout; read-only against the sites, so repeating the same request is safe.

aiMetadata.description: Starts from a base URL, discovers and follows links across the site, and returns the content of many pages in a chosen format (markdown, HTML, links, summary, screenshot, or AI-extracted JSON). Choose this to gather content from a whole site or section; use Scrape for a single page or Map to only list URLs without fetching content. Bounded by the page limit and timeout, and can deliver results to a webhook. Read-only against the site, so re-running the same call is safe.

crawlResults.name: crawlResults
crawlResults.description: Get the results of a crawl job.

crawlId.description: The ID of the crawl job to check.

aiMetadata.description: Looks up the status and accumulated page results of a previously started crawl job by its crawl ID. Choose this to poll or fetch the output of a Crawl run that delivered an ID rather than waiting inline. Requires a valid crawl ID; it is a read-only lookup, so repeating the call is safe.

map.name: map
map.description: Input a website and get all the urls on the website.

url.description: The webpage URL to start scraping from.

subdomain.description: Include and crawl pages from subdomains of the target website (e.g., blog.example.com, shop.example.com) in addition to the main domain.

limit.description: Maximum number of links to return (max: 100,000)

aiMetadata.description: Discovers and returns the list of URLs reachable from a given website, optionally including subdomains, up to a configurable limit. Choose this for fast site-map / link discovery when you only need the URLs and not page content; follow with Scrape, Crawl, or Extract to fetch the pages. Read-only against the site, so repeating the call is safe.

pt.\nFollow these steps to obtain your Fire:
Siga estes passos para obter sua chave de API do Firecrawl:

1. Visite [Firecrawl](https://firecrawl.dev) e crie uma conta.
2. Entre e navegue para o seu painel.
3. Localize e copie sua chave de API na seção de configurações da API.
